title: Huawei Watch 2 Collector + T:slim x2 connection Issues
body: So I have the Huawei watch 2 patched with the care pack zip. Without the watch as a collector the phone and x2 get readings every 5 minutes fine. With the watch as a collector it seems the watch and x2 are fighting with each other to connect. Only one or the other will get readings at a time but not both.

comments.body:
